# Badges

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Badges (tags, in the original) are README badges won by skipping a small or big
blind; each of them shows the badge it gives. Some act right away, others wait
for the next shop, blind or boss. badges: 2x copies the next badge won.

| Id | Badge | Effect | From ante | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stars100` | `stars: 100` | The next shop has a free extra joker | 1 | *Popular enough.* |
| `stars10k` | `stars: 10k` | The next shop has a free AUR joker | 1 | *Trending on GitHub.* |
| `opacity0` | `opacity: 0` | The next shop joker becomes Transparent, for free | 2 | *You can't see it. It's there.* |
| `blur_on` | `blur: on` | The next shop joker gets Blur, for free | 1 | *Looks expensive. Isn't.* |
| `shadow_on` | `shadow: on` | The next shop joker gets Shadow, for free | 1 | *Depth, on the house.* |
| `animations_on` | `animations: on` | The next shop joker gets Animated, for free | 1 | *Wobbly, and free.* |
| `series_a` | `funding: series A` | +$25 after beating the next boss | 1 | *Burn rate: acceptable.* |
| `prs_welcome` | `PRs: welcome` | Adds a pull request to the next shop | 1 | *Contributions encouraged.* |
| `wontfix` | `wontfix` | Rerolls the next boss | 1 | *Closed as not planned.* |

| `gc_done` | `gc: done` | +$1 per discard left unused this game | 2 | *Memory reclaimed. Money too.* |
| `price_free` | `price: free` | Cards and packs in the next shop are free | 1 | *Free as in beer. Again.* |
